---
title: "Leaderboards"
---

Compare per-match performance across key stats. Use the filters to focus on a season or round, and adjust the minimum matches threshold to ensure rates are meaningful.

<div class="leaderboard-controls">
  <div class="control">
    <label for="season-filter">Season</label>
    <select id="season-filter"></select>
  </div>
  <div class="control">
    <label for="round-filter">Round</label>
    <select id="round-filter"></select>
  </div>
  <div class="control">
    <label for="min-matches">Minimum matches</label>
    <input id="min-matches" type="number" min="1" value="3" />
  </div>
</div>

<section class="leaderboard-section">
  <h2>MVP Votes</h2>
  <div id="mvp-table"></div>
</section>

<section class="leaderboard-section">
  <h2>Aces</h2>
  <div id="aces-table"></div>
</section>

<section class="leaderboard-section">
  <h2>Winners</h2>
  <div id="winners-table"></div>
</section>

<section class="leaderboard-section">
  <h2>Errors Forced</h2>
  <div id="forced-errors-table"></div>
</section>

<section class="leaderboard-section">
  <h2>Unforced Errors</h2>
  <div id="unforced-errors-table"></div>
</section>

<script>
const leaderboardState = {
  rows: [],
  season: "All",
  round: "All",
  minMatches: 3,
};

const metrics = [
  { key: "MVP Votes", label: "MVP Votes", container: "mvp-table" },
  { key: "Aces", label: "Aces", container: "aces-table" },
  { key: "Winners", label: "Winners", container: "winners-table" },
  { key: "Errors Forced", label: "Errors Forced", container: "forced-errors-table" },
  { key: "Unforced Errors", label: "Unforced Errors", container: "unforced-errors-table" },
];

function parseCsv(text) {
  const lines = text.trim().split(/\r?\n/);
  if (!lines.length) return [];
  const headers = lines.shift().split(",").map((header) => header.replace(/^\uFEFF/, "").trim());
  return lines
    .filter((line) => line.trim().length)
    .map((line) => {
      const values = line.split(",");
      const row = {};
      headers.forEach((header, index) => {
        row[header] = values[index] ?? "";
      });
      return row;
    });
}

function toNumber(value) {
  const parsed = Number(value);
  return Number.isFinite(parsed) ? parsed : 0;
}

function populateFilters() {
  const seasonSelect = document.getElementById("season-filter");
  const roundSelect = document.getElementById("round-filter");
  const seasons = new Set();
  const rounds = new Set();

  leaderboardState.rows.forEach((row) => {
    if (row.Season) seasons.add(row.Season);
    if (row.Round) rounds.add(row.Round);
  });

  const buildOptions = (select, values) => {
    select.innerHTML = "";
    const allOption = document.createElement("option");
    allOption.value = "All";
    allOption.textContent = "All";
    select.appendChild(allOption);

    Array.from(values)
      .sort((a, b) => Number(a) - Number(b))
      .forEach((value) => {
        const option = document.createElement("option");
        option.value = value;
        option.textContent = value;
        select.appendChild(option);
      });
  };

  buildOptions(seasonSelect, seasons);
  buildOptions(roundSelect, rounds);
}

function aggregateStats(rows) {
  const byPlayer = new Map();

  rows.forEach((row) => {
    const player = row.Player || "Unknown";
    if (!byPlayer.has(player)) {
      byPlayer.set(player, {
        player,
        matches: 0,
        totals: {
          "MVP Votes": 0,
          Aces: 0,
          Winners: 0,
          "Errors Forced": 0,
          "Unforced Errors": 0,
        },
      });
    }

    const entry = byPlayer.get(player);
    entry.matches += 1;
    entry.totals["MVP Votes"] += toNumber(row["MVP Votes"]);
    entry.totals.Aces += toNumber(row.Aces);
    entry.totals.Winners += toNumber(row.Winners);
    entry.totals["Errors Forced"] += toNumber(row["Errors Forced"]);
    entry.totals["Unforced Errors"] += toNumber(row["Unforced Errors"]);
  });

  return Array.from(byPlayer.values());
}

function makeSortable(table) {
  const headers = table.querySelectorAll("th");
  headers.forEach((header) => {
    header.addEventListener("click", () => {
      const tbody = table.querySelector("tbody");
      const rows = Array.from(tbody.querySelectorAll("tr"));
      const index = header.cellIndex;
      const type = header.dataset.type || "text";
      const current = header.dataset.sortDir || "desc";
      const nextDir = current === "asc" ? "desc" : "asc";

      headers.forEach((h) => h.removeAttribute("data-sort-dir"));
      header.dataset.sortDir = nextDir;

      rows.sort((a, b) => {
        const aValue = a.children[index].dataset.sortValue || a.children[index].textContent;
        const bValue = b.children[index].dataset.sortValue || b.children[index].textContent;
        if (type === "number") {
          return (Number(aValue) - Number(bValue)) * (nextDir === "asc" ? 1 : -1);
        }
        return aValue.localeCompare(bValue) * (nextDir === "asc" ? 1 : -1);
      });

      rows.forEach((row) => tbody.appendChild(row));
    });
  });
}

function renderTable(containerId, metricKey, entries) {
  const container = document.getElementById(containerId);
  container.innerHTML = "";

  const table = document.createElement("table");
  table.className = "leaderboard-table";

  table.innerHTML = `
    <thead>
      <tr>
        <th data-type="text">Player</th>
        <th data-type="number">Matches</th>
        <th data-type="number">Total</th>
        <th data-type="number">Per Match</th>
      </tr>
    </thead>
    <tbody></tbody>
  `;

  const tbody = table.querySelector("tbody");

  entries.forEach((entry) => {
    const row = document.createElement("tr");
    row.innerHTML = `
      <td>${entry.player}</td>
      <td data-sort-value="${entry.matches}">${entry.matches}</td>
      <td data-sort-value="${entry.total}">${entry.total.toFixed(1)}</td>
      <td data-sort-value="${entry.rate}">${entry.rate.toFixed(2)}</td>
    `;
    tbody.appendChild(row);
  });

  container.appendChild(table);
  makeSortable(table);
}

function updateTables() {
  const season = leaderboardState.season;
  const round = leaderboardState.round;
  const minMatches = leaderboardState.minMatches;

  const filtered = leaderboardState.rows.filter((row) => {
    const seasonMatch = season === "All" || row.Season === season;
    const roundMatch = round === "All" || row.Round === round;
    return seasonMatch && roundMatch;
  });

  const entries = aggregateStats(filtered);

  metrics.forEach((metric) => {
    const rows = entries
      .filter((entry) => entry.matches >= minMatches)
      .map((entry) => {
        const total = entry.totals[metric.key] || 0;
        return {
          player: entry.player,
          matches: entry.matches,
          total,
          rate: entry.matches ? total / entry.matches : 0,
        };
      })
      .sort((a, b) => b.rate - a.rate);

    renderTable(metric.container, metric.key, rows);
  });
}

function bindControls() {
  const seasonSelect = document.getElementById("season-filter");
  const roundSelect = document.getElementById("round-filter");
  const minMatchesInput = document.getElementById("min-matches");

  seasonSelect.addEventListener("change", (event) => {
    leaderboardState.season = event.target.value;
    updateTables();
  });

  roundSelect.addEventListener("change", (event) => {
    leaderboardState.round = event.target.value;
    updateTables();
  });

  minMatchesInput.addEventListener("input", (event) => {
    const value = Number(event.target.value);
    leaderboardState.minMatches = Number.isFinite(value) && value > 0 ? value : 1;
    updateTables();
  });
}

async function initLeaderboards() {
  const response = await fetch("data/match_stats.csv");
  const text = await response.text();
  leaderboardState.rows = parseCsv(text);
  populateFilters();
  bindControls();
  updateTables();
}

initLeaderboards();
</script>
